Create LOBO_API_KEY in the config once (kept across ups) and write opencode.lobo.json with it

Usage:
  lobo gen-api-key [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help     help for gen-api-key
      --rotate   replace the existing key

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
